payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, specifically through a multimodal approach that combines visual and textual information.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by using a multimodal approach that integrates visual context with textual information.
The proposed multimodal NER (MNER) system significantly outperforms traditional text-only NER models by leveraging visual contexts alongside text.
